name: Training Volume & Isolation Engine
changes: Expanded 5-day programme with more isolation work across chest, delts, back, arms, legs, glutes, calves and core
Exercise metadata: BASE / ISOLATION / CORE and optional flag
Optional isolation blocks for fatigue/recovery flexibility
Core work added with L5-S1-conscious anti-extension/anti-rotation choices
known_limitations: New exercises reuse generic/mockup media asset paths until dedicated demo/anatomy assets are produced
Weekly volume counts direct sets and estimates secondary contribution at 0.5x for display only
Optional isolation blocks are user-selectable conceptually but automatic readiness-based hiding is not yet implemented
